# Alert engine evaluation (generated by `python -m scripts.evaluate_alerts`)

Synthetic data, seed 42, 150 patients, 182 days. Engine replayed daily from day 112. Rules version rules-0.2.0. Numbers are measured, not edited.

## seizure_increase on `rising` patients

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| injected cases | 17 |
| flagged after onset (sensitivity) | 15/17 = 0.882 |
| median days from onset to first flag | 22 |
| range of days to flag | 9–29 |
| stable patients wrongly flagged (false alarm rate) | 18/107 = 0.168 |

Not flagged: P-7DBEDD, P-8810C2 (onset day(s) 154, 136).

## adherence_drop on `poor_adherence` patients

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| injected cases | 13 |
| flagged after onset (sensitivity) | 13/13 = 1.000 |
| median days from onset to first flag | 5 |
| range of days to flag | 2–10 |
| stable patients wrongly flagged (false alarm rate) | 18/107 = 0.168 |

## Trend threshold trade-off (exploration on the same data — for the neurologist to decide)

| max_p_value | min_recent_count | sensitivity (rising) | median days to flag | false alarm rate (stable) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.05 | 3 | 17/17 | 12 | 43/107 |
| 0.01 (config default) | 3 | 15/17 | 22 | 18/107 |
| 0.01 | 4 | 14/17 | 22.0 | 18/107 |
| 0.001 | 3 | 11/17 | 25 | 8/107 |

## Queue snapshot on the last day (flag rate)

| tier | patients | share |
|---|---|---|
| urgent | 7 | 4.7% |
| review | 25 | 16.7% |
| info | 17 | 11.3% |
| stable | 101 | 67.3% |

Shown by default (urgent + needs review): 32/150 = 21.3%.

## Low-threshold queue view (F2: p < 0.05, presentation only)

Rising patients missed by the default trend alert, checked against the low-threshold view:

| patient | onset day | first day in low-threshold view | days after onset | in the view on the last day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P-7DBEDD | 154 | 154 | 0 | yes |
| P-8810C2 | 136 | 136 | 0 | no |

A flag on the onset day itself (0 days) means the patient's count was already borderline before the injected rise started: the low-threshold view includes these patients, but partly by chance, not as proof that it detects the rise faster.

On the last day the low-threshold view adds **6** patient(s) to the 32 in the default queue: 2 with injected rising seizures, 4 without (false alarms). (P-5B0A31, P-03F89C, P-7DBEDD, P-FFC64A, P-A6309F, P-008B5D)

Note: some rising/poor-adherence onsets fall before day 112; for those, detection is counted from day 112 and the delay is still measured from the true onset, so their delays are longer.
